suggestions.reason: The result.md self-reports the confirmation phrase — no raw transcript is available to independently verify the exact wording or ordering of steps. The eval would be stronger if the transcript (not just a summary) were captured so graders can verify the sequence of events directly.

No assertion checks that the commit message is meaningful and correctly describes the change (not just that it exists and lacks attribution). A trivial or wrong message would pass all current assertions.

eval_feedback.overall: Core behavioral assertions are well-targeted. The main gap is relying on executor self-reporting rather than a raw transcript for the confirmation-ordering check.
